season_water_13_entry.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_entry.text: Yu opened the door on the gathering's second morning, during the short visit the household had actually offered. Jun had put the private terms beside the panels in their real state. Qiu's gift of greens was accepted as a neighbor's gift and kept separate from every agreement. Lin took the dry bench with her shoulder supported. Before discussing the market's public passage, they would hear what the household's earlier chosen terms now required and what work had really been performed.

season_water_13_intro_002.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_intro_002.text: When the private account had been heard and put away under its stated limits, Jun opened a different paper: the gathering's stall map. A temporary line across the public foot passage was labeled reserve for carts. The line ran between the two boundary stones already identified beside the storehouse. It did not become a lawful exclusion simply because the map looked tidy. Yu wanted the women to hear the complaint without treating the household's private sale or refusal as its proof.

season_water_13_intro_003.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_intro_003.text: The gathering manager had placed empty cart frames across part of the identified public passage to organize the morning queue. He had permission to use a nearby loading square, not to transfer the foot passage into a reserve. Fen's actual work barrier remained beyond it under the maintenance order, and that legitimate exclusion was a different line. Qiu noticed how easily the two lines could merge on a small map. Lin asked Jun where the manager's own permission ended.

season_water_13_intro_004.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_intro_004.text: Jun had a copy of the gathering notice supplied to stallholders. It named the loading square and its hours, with no authority over the identified foot passage. She permitted the women to use that public notice, not the household order slips, in a bounded question to the responsible keeper. Qiu read the limit aloud. Yu said she would be satisfied if no one turned their complaint into a story about grateful panel sellers seeking a favor.

season_water_13_intro_005.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_intro_005.text: Su received the public source through the facility's ordinary counter. The forty-copper account could support its existing explanation work, but it did not pay for removing carts, buying stalls, or compensating buyers. The responsible keeper confirmed the foot-passage agreement's scope and the separate loading-square permission. He sent a current direction to the manager: clear the identified passage within the ordinary permitted approach conditions. Lin and Qiu did not issue that direction themselves.

season_water_13_intro_006.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_intro_006.text: The manager cleared the cart frames to the authorized loading square. The actual foot passage became available under its current keeper notice before the room chose any further undertaking. Some stallholders lost queue position because the carts could no longer wait in the narrow line. Other travelers stopped being forced around the map's invented reserve. The manager was not a villain who wanted the river to win. He had made convenient space into authority, and the correction cost real convenience.

season_water_13_intro_007.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
season_water_13_intro_007.text: We should not describe the clearing as ours. The keeper gave the direction, and the manager's people did the work within their own permissions. We supplied and read the public notice that showed the limit. I can be pleased that the question mattered without claiming the hands that moved the frames. I also want to hear why the authorized loading square was not used in the first place, because the inconvenience may return under another neat label.

season_water_13_intro_008.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_intro_008.text: The manager said the loading square was farther from the early stalls. A cart held there missed the first call if the seller could not hear the queue keeper. His improvised reserve had solved that problem by borrowing public ground he did not control. Lin understood the practical need and did not accept the borrowed authority. Su offered the gathering's ordinary parties a short facility conversation to consider a permitted queue signal, if they wished, within the next available interval.

season_water_13_intro_009.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_intro_009.text: The manager and stallholders consented to that bounded conversation. The keeper would attend for its permitted passage condition and loading-square scope, then return to ordinary duty. Jun wanted to ask a broader question about repeated lost departures, but she did not consent to expose her private order. Ma wanted a clear space for hand-carried baskets rather than another favorable paragraph about access. Two undertakings competed for the limited room: practical queue signaling or a public account of who bore the detours.

season_water_13_intro_010.speaker: rival_su_yao
season_water_13_intro_010.text: The passage is already cleared under the keeper's direction. We are not choosing whether people deserve it. We can use the interval to test a permitted queue signal from the loading square, with the gathering's actual people doing their own work. Or we can hear bounded accounts of the detours and put the cost beside the public source limits. The first may help tomorrow's call; the second may help the responsible decision about future gatherings. We cannot perform both fully today.

season_water_13_intro_011.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_intro_011.text: Qiu preferred the signal trial because tomorrow's carts would otherwise meet the same hearing problem. Lin preferred the bounded cost hearing because a practical workaround could make the original overreach seem harmless after all. The manager said he would attend either, then caught himself asking the room to praise his cooperation before anything happened. Su thanked him for accepting the correction without making his courtesy the reason the foot passage remained public.

season_water_13_intro_012.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_intro_012.text: Ma laid her empty basket beside the rail and said a signal could help her seller nephew, while a cost hearing could explain why she refused another long detour. She wanted neither use to certify her ankle for strangers. Jun offered only the public facts she had already allowed and one general preparation interval, without a price or roof story. The sources were willing to contribute bounded accounts; their willingness did not create an unlimited supply of vivid household detail.

season_water_13_choice.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_choice.text: Lin checked the remaining free interval against the keeper's departure time. Qiu checked the loading-square sight line on the supplied map, without leaving the dry approach to inspect unpermitted ground. Their work still depended on others' actual permissions and ordinary skills. The choice would change what was completed before tomorrow's first call, not merely which heading went over the same activity. Su asked Lin to name the undertaking she could honestly help finish.

choices.text: Test a permitted queue signal for the next actual call
Hear bounded detour costs beside the authority limit

season_water_13_signal_entry.speaker: lin_yue
season_water_13_signal_entry.text: Let us test the permitted queue signal. The cleared passage and the manager's earlier overreach will remain plainly recorded; a useful signal will not excuse them. Tomorrow's call is close enough that we can help the gathering's own people check what the loading square actually needs. We will use the authorized dry positions, ask the participants to read the signal back, and stop if the ordinary permissions do not support the test.

season_water_13_signal_002.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_signal_002.text: The manager brought the actual queue keeper and a stallholder who used a handcart. The responsible keeper approved the loading square's marked standing places under its current condition. Qiu proposed a lifted white cloth for the next cart, but the queue keeper said laundry on a nearby line would make it ambiguous. The objection came from ordinary work, not from a rival trying to spoil an elegant idea. Qiu discarded the cloth proposal before anyone relied on it.

season_water_13_signal_003.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_signal_003.text: The queue keeper offered a small square board with a dark diagonal already used for gathering calls on the authorized square. Its use was within his actual work and did not require buying a facility panel. The test would check whether the stallholder could distinguish the raised call from the lowered waiting position. Lin read back the meaning from behind the cold rail while the manager's own people placed the board at its approved position.

season_water_13_signal_004.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_signal_004.text: The first test failed. From the far dry standing mark, the raised board blended with a cart roof. The stallholder did not move, then moved late when the manager shouted an extra cue. Qiu wrote the failure without calling the shouted cue part of the proposed signal. Lin asked the queue keeper whether a different authorized position was available. He named one nearer the square's inner wall, within the same permitted ground and visible from the waiting mark.

season_water_13_signal_005.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
season_water_13_signal_005.text: The first board did not work from the agreed standing place. I liked it because it used what the gathering already had, but thrift is not visibility. Let us try the keeper's second permitted position without changing the signal's meaning. If it still needs an extra shout to be understood, the test should say so. We are not obliged to save the proposal merely because it is mine and the available interval is getting shorter.

season_water_13_signal_006.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_signal_006.text: At the second position, the stallholder correctly distinguished three actual raised calls from two lowered waits. The queue keeper reversed the order so expectation would not carry the response. A different stallholder then read the same sequence correctly from the authorized dry mark. The test did not certify every crowd, light, or future weather condition. It established a usable signal for this current arrangement and named the need to recheck it when those conditions changed.

season_water_13_signal_007.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_signal_007.text: Ma's nephew used the permitted square on the next ordinary call under the gathering's own work. He heard the signal meaning before moving his cart and reached the stall without borrowing the foot passage. Ma still carried her basket along the public strip rather than yielding it to waiting frames. The practical gain was visible in two simultaneous ordinary journeys. Neither depended on declaring the manager's original map line valid after the fact.

season_water_13_signal_008.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_signal_008.text: The manager changed tomorrow's gathering notice to name the permitted loading square and its current signal. The keeper checked the passage boundary and retained the maintenance exclusion separately. Lin checked the wording did not promise a permanently open approach. Qiu removed a repeated direction that obscured the signal's raised and lowered meanings. This time her economy made the actual instruction clearer, because the source distinctions remained in the lines she kept.

season_water_13_signal_009.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_signal_009.text: Jun asked when the broader detour costs would be heard. Su gave the ordinary receiving channel and its next permitted opportunity, without promising the household as a witness. The chosen signal work had not held a full cost hearing. Jun's private order account remained closed in its own envelope. The source limit had survived the temptation to tell a satisfying story in which one successful cart call proved every affected household had recovered its lost market week.

season_water_13_signal_010.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_signal_010.text: After the test, Qiu thanked the queue keeper for rejecting the white cloth. He said he would have rejected it from anyone; the laundry line was there regardless of whose brush drew the plan. Qiu laughed and accepted the fairness of that answer. Lin kept the first failed position in the test record. The working second position had been earned through an actual failed attempt and a responsible alternative, with the future recheck boundary still visible.

season_water_13_signal_011.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_signal_011.text: The stallholder who had moved late on the first test lost part of his preparation interval and could not set out one tray before the early buyers passed. He accepted the bounded trial but wanted the missed tray noted. Su received the permitted fact without a price claim. A successful second arrangement did not make the first failure free. Qiu named that cost in her closing account, rather than asking the stallholder to agree that the final usefulness justified his missing buyers.

season_water_13_signal_012.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_signal_012.text: At closing, the gathering's own people retained the board and the signal duty. Lin and Qiu took no standing role in tomorrow's calls. The manager's earlier overreach stayed withdrawn; the permitted square now had a tested current arrangement. The broader detour hearing remained unperformed today. Su closed the room at its agreed time, and Ma left by the clear public strip with her basket, without signing any statement that practical improvement had settled every loss.

season_water_13_costs_entry.speaker: lin_yue
season_water_13_costs_entry.text: Let us hear the bounded detour costs. The manager must still use the authorized loading square tomorrow, and the keeper's clearing direction remains in force. We should not let a quick workaround become the whole account of borrowing public passage. Ma and Jun have offered specific permitted facts. The manager can describe the hearing problem without turning it into authority over the strip. We will keep private orders and household prices out of the record.

season_water_13_costs_002.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_costs_002.text: Su arranged the short hearing around three actual accounts: a basket detour, a preparation interval lost when a departure changed, and the loading square's distant call. The speakers chose their own words within the permissions already stated. Lin remained seated behind the cold rail and read the public source boundaries. Qiu kept the questions to the named accounts. The keeper listened for passage scope, not as a judge empowered to award compensation from the facility fund.

season_water_13_costs_003.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_costs_003.text: Ma described the extra dry distance and the need to rest before reaching the stall. She did not disclose a medical history or ask the women to speak for everyone with a sore ankle. The manager asked whether she could have come earlier. Ma answered that his map had changed the available approach after she had packed. Qiu allowed the question to stand as part of the hearing and prevented it from becoming a judgment about Ma's virtue.

season_water_13_costs_004.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_costs_004.text: Jun described one ordinary preparation interval lost when a departure was uncertain. She used a general example she permitted, with no private price, buyer, or roof account attached. A listener tried to connect it to the household panels people had seen near Yu's door. Lin stopped the identification and returned to the stated example. The room did not need ownership of Jun's private sale or refusal to understand that uncertain access could make household work unusable for a particular call.

season_water_13_costs_005.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_costs_005.text: The manager described the distant loading call and why he had placed carts nearer the stalls. The keeper confirmed the permitted square remained his proper place and the foot passage remained outside his reserve authority. The hearing did not erase the practical hearing problem. It put that problem beside the people who had borne the unauthorized solution's cost. A listener proposed calling the inconvenience mutual. Ma said the manager had chosen whose ground and legs would absorb it.

season_water_13_costs_006.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
season_water_13_costs_006.text: Both accounts can be real without the authority being equal. The loading square is inconvenient for the gathering's call. That fact supports asking for a permitted signal or a new actual arrangement. It does not support inventing a reserve on the public strip. Ma's detour is not a failure to appreciate your difficulty. It is part of the cost of the solution you chose without the authority to choose it for that ground.

season_water_13_costs_007.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_costs_007.text: The manager accepted that distinction and withdrew the reserve line in his own gathering notice. The keeper had already directed the physical clearing; the written correction now came from the party who had made the map. Lin checked that the maintenance work barrier stayed separately named. The record did not transfer the storehouse ground into public ownership or promise open passage through every future repair. It preserved the actual agreement between the two identified stones and its ordinary exclusions.

season_water_13_costs_008.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_costs_008.text: The hearing interval did not contain a signal test. Tomorrow's first loading call would use the manager's existing authorized square and ordinary audible arrangement, with the practical limitation still unresolved. Qiu asked whether the room could simply add one quick board test after the accounts. Su said there was no agreed time or keeper permission left for that undertaking. Qiu stopped. Respecting the boundary mattered most when the omitted work looked easy and useful.

season_water_13_costs_009.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_costs_009.text: A stallholder missed tomorrow's early call because he could not hear it from the permitted square. He did not return to the foot strip; the keeper's direction remained clear. The gathering's own people arranged a later call through their ordinary channel, but the first buyers had passed. The cost hearing had made the overreach visible and did not solve the operational hearing problem in time. Lin retained that unfinished practical need without using it to discredit the testimony.

season_water_13_costs_010.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_costs_010.text: Ma said the hearing had helped her refuse the next detour without being told she was merely impatient. Jun said the privacy boundary had mattered more to her than the final polished paragraph. Neither woman signed a general satisfaction statement. Su accepted their permitted closing remarks and left the private household account untouched. The room had made actual responsibility more legible, while the next day's signal problem remained for its proper workers to solve.

season_water_13_costs_011.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_costs_011.text: Qiu admitted that she had wanted the cost hearing to produce a practical arrangement at once. Lin said she had wanted the practical need to disappear once the overreach was named. Neither wish had been granted. Their chosen undertaking had answered the authority and burden question for these sources. It had not tested a queue signal. The missing answer could remain in the record without becoming a reason to pretend the completed hearing had accomplished nothing.

season_water_13_costs_012.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_costs_012.text: Su closed the hearing at the agreed time and sent the permitted account through the responsible gathering channel. No private panel price appeared in it, and no public copper was promised as household compensation. The manager retained his own work duty, the keeper retained passage authority, and the women retained only the bounded reading they had performed. Ma left by the cleared strip. The next early call would still require an actual operational answer from the gathering's people.

season_water_13_after_001.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_after_001.text: The gathering ended with a scatter of husks under the stalls and tired people counting what they had actually sold. Yu's private panel terms had reached their genuine conclusion before the public passage conversation. The facility account did not absorb those prices or retained materials. Su held the public gathering source and its permitted corrections, while the household kept its own envelopes. There was no single purse called recovery into which every successful act could be poured.

season_water_13_after_002.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_after_002.text: Qiu met Yu at the ordinary dry corner after the stalls closed. She asked whether she could walk part of the way with her. Yu said yes, and asked for no account of the afternoon until they reached the quiet turn. Qiu obeyed. Lin followed at a distance sufficient to give them the conversation they had chosen, then joined only when Yu called her name. Friendship was not a corridor through which every private fact had to pass to the public room.

season_water_13_after_003.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_after_003.text: Yu said she had disliked hearing strangers praise the household's patience. Patience was sometimes just the absence of a useful alternative. Qiu asked whether her own praise had sounded that way. Yu said once, and named the actual sentence from an earlier visit without turning it into a permanent accusation. Qiu listened. Lin kept her light notebook shut because the correction belonged to their conversation, not because the phrase lacked value for an essay about seasonal work.

season_water_13_after_004.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
season_water_13_after_004.text: I did mean to honor the work. I also made it sound as though your willingness to endure the loss was the work I admired most. That is an easier thing for a visitor to praise than your right to be angry or refuse. I can change that sentence when I speak with you. I cannot make every stranger understand by telling them more of your private life. I will not use your account of this moment without asking you.

season_water_13_after_005.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_after_005.text: Yu said she wanted the changed habit, not a published apology. She also wanted Qiu to keep visiting when there was no useful source to collect. Qiu accepted the invitation for a later ordinary meal only after checking the time. Lin declined that particular meal because of an existing commitment, and Yu took the answer without making absence a measure of affection. The season's work had brought them closer without acquiring ownership of their calendars.

season_water_13_after_006.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_after_006.text: The keeper's seasonal source folder now held the public foot-passage agreement, the gate-name correction, the local reference account, the withdrawn reassurance, and the gathering permission limit. It did not hold Yu's private buyer slips, Ren's private cord story, or worker names withheld by the downstream keeper. Its incompleteness had reasons. Su made those reasons findable for the next permitted reviewer, so an empty sleeve would not become an invitation to collect what the owners had refused.

season_water_13_after_007.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_after_007.text: Lin checked the public passage wording once more against the two identified stones. It named hand-carried goods and foot passage under current conditions, with actual temporary work exclusions retained. The gathering manager's cart reserve had not enlarged those exclusions. The correction had not erased the storehouse ground-holder's ownership beyond the strip. A clear right could be defended at its real size, without pretending that the wider ground had become common because several people needed it.

season_water_13_after_008.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_after_008.text: Ma brought one last question about the phrase ordinary exclusion. She wanted to know whether the next convenient cart line could be called ordinary and escape challenge. Su asked the responsible keeper to answer through his actual scope. He said an exclusion required the proper authority and stated condition; the phrase did not create permission for any convenient obstruction. Ma repeated that back, then said she would use it herself if the next map forgot the difference.

season_water_13_after_009.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_after_009.text: Qiu wanted to put Ma's sentence at the top of the account. Ma allowed its practical meaning but not an attributed quotation. Qiu revised it into a source-supported distinction and showed Ma the result before using it. The process took longer than lifting the vivid words whole. It kept Ma from becoming an unwilling emblem of access. Lin saw that Qiu's speed had not vanished; it had found a boundary she was choosing not to cross for elegance.

season_water_13_after_010.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_after_010.text: The remaining seasonal invitations were checked against ordinary commitments rather than made into an uninterrupted mission. Lin's shoulder still limited reaching, carrying, and long unsupported sitting. Su arranged the current permitted reading position with a backrest when the room was used; she did not announce a cure. Qiu sometimes worked alone within an agreed source check while Lin was absent. The work retained its own supervision and evidence, instead of using absence to invent extra competence for either woman.

season_water_13_after_011.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_after_011.text: A weather notice arrived through the responsible local channel near the end of the gathering week. It did not predict the whole river from four quiet mornings. It named the current expected rain conditions within its actual source scope and where local updates would appear. Bao checked his station preparation under his ordinary duty. The women received an invitation for a later limited indoor information interval, not for a night rescue watch or a journey along the wet bank.

season_water_13_after_012.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_after_012.text: Su made the offered scope plain before anyone accepted. The room could help read the responsible notices, distinguish fresh observations from relayed ones, and direct permitted questions to the proper desks. It could not promise shelter beyond authorized places, move barriers, or improvise river operations. Lin and Qiu checked the indoor interval against their own obligations and accepted it. The household buyer account was closed; the next storm would not reopen a completed sale or manufacture one from a refused offer.

season_water_13_recall.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_recall.text: At the close of the gathering record, the chosen undertaking still mattered. A tested permitted signal and a bounded cost hearing were not interchangeable successes. One had helped a current cart call while leaving fuller detour testimony waiting; the other had made burden and authority visible while leaving the early hearing problem unresolved. Su asked the women to preserve that difference before the next weather interval made the season seem like one continuous emergency.

season_water_13_signal_cb_001.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_signal_cb_001.text: The chosen signal undertaking had failed at its first permitted position, then succeeded at the keeper's second approved position with actual read-back trials. The gathering's own people retained the board and call duty. A stallholder lost preparation time during the first failed test; Ma's nephew later used the authorized square without borrowing the foot strip. The broader detour cost hearing was not performed that day. The manager's overreach remained withdrawn, rather than excused by the useful signal.

season_water_13_signal_cb_002.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
season_water_13_signal_cb_002.text: The working second position did not arrive by the force of my first idea. The queue keeper rejected the ambiguous cloth, the first board view failed, and the responsible alternative earned its usefulness in actual trials. Lin kept the failures in the record. I want that account when people praise the final efficiency. It shows a practical gain with its cost and limit, while leaving the fuller burden question for its proper later channel.

season_water_13_costs_cb_001.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_costs_cb_001.text: The chosen hearing had preserved Ma's basket detour, Jun's permitted general preparation interval, and the manager's real hearing problem without taking private household prices or roof details. It made the authority limit clear and obtained the manager's written withdrawal of the invented reserve. It did not test a queue signal. A stallholder missed the next early call from the authorized square, and that practical cost remained visible beside the hearing's usefulness rather than being blamed on the witnesses.

season_water_13_costs_cb_002.speaker: lin_yue
season_water_13_costs_cb_002.text: The hearing let actual people describe the burden of a solution chosen over ground the manager did not control. Qiu kept the practical hearing problem in view, even when I wanted responsibility alone to settle the afternoon. We did not solve that problem within our chosen interval. Ma gained a clear boundary she could use herself; Jun's private account stayed private. Those are real gains, and the missed early call is a real unfinished cost.

season_water_13_close_001.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_close_001.text: Su closed the public gathering sleeve and left the household envelopes with their owners. The keeper's current passage notice remained in its ordinary place. The seasonal fund still awaited its final authorized witness and cleanup services; no private panel sale had changed that amount. Lin left the room at the agreed time, carrying only light notes. Qiu stayed for no extra duty merely because the next rain had become a subject of conversation.

season_water_13_close_002.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_close_002.text: At the dry turn, the two women watched market workers fold their own canvas under the gathering's ordinary arrangements. A corner caught the breeze and snapped like a sail before being lowered. Lin felt the old desire to turn the scene into a lesson about boundaries. Qiu asked whether she was about to say something useful. Lin said perhaps, then chose to say the canvas sounded satisfyingly loud. Qiu agreed with that smaller observation.

season_water_13_close_003.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_close_003.text: The next days belonged partly to work the seasonal account would never contain. Lin fulfilled her ordinary commitments and kept her shoulder within its limit. Qiu visited Yu at the accepted meal and talked about a neighbor's terrible pickles, which no one permitted the public room to quote. Su served other facility users under their own bookings. Their lives did not become empty waiting rooms between river chapters, and the rain did not grant the narrative authority over every hour.

season_water_13_close_004.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_close_004.text: When the accepted indoor weather interval came, the air was already full of the low hiss of rain on stone. The responsible notices named their actual local conditions and authorized information points. Lin arrived by the currently verified dry approach before its later review time. Qiu had arrived through her own permitted route. They sat where Su directed, with a cold rail between their table and the working passage, ready to read what had actually been supplied.

season_water_13_order_recall.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_order_recall.text: Yu placed the earlier chosen terms where everyone could read them without surrendering the household envelope. An accepted later order would require actual completed work, buyer inspection, and payment under that order. A refusal would require no invented delivery or money. The household wanted the women to hear its real account before using any part of the morning for public passage. Lin read the relevant terms aloud, leaving the private prices outside the facility's seasonal ledger.

season_water_13_order_notice_001.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_order_notice_001.text: The household's accepted later order concerned two repaired panels at four copper together, after inspection on the gathering's second morning. Today's earlier cancellation remained on its own slip: no panels delivered and no copper earned that day. Jun brought the two actual panels to the dry downstairs table. She had used the ordinary afternoons named in her plan for drying and edge work; she now showed the final doubtful section that still required attention before either panel could be offered.

season_water_13_order_notice_002.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_order_notice_002.text: Yu held the first edge flat while Jun examined each repaired knot in the remaining section. They worked with their familiar household tools, pausing when the light failed behind a cloud. Lin sat with the buyer's size description on her lap and read it only when Jun asked. Qiu kept the visitor cups away from the work. Neither woman tied a knot, certified a net, or took the household's demonstrated skill into her own account.

season_water_13_order_notice_003.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_order_notice_003.text: The doubtful strand needed replacing. Jun cut only the marked damaged portion and tied the sound replacement into the edge, then let Yu check the settled knot and the size. The other panel's final check found no new doubtful section under the agreed condition. Jun rested her fingers before rolling either piece. The work was visibly completed here before the buyer's inspection, rather than hidden inside the promise that sufficient afternoons had passed.

season_water_13_order_notice_004.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
season_water_13_order_notice_004.text: The two panels are ready to be offered under the terms you accepted. That is different from having been accepted already. I can read the inspection condition again if you want it, and I can leave the price where it belongs in your private slip. The public room has no claim on this sale because we sat here. Your canceled earlier departure also remains canceled; today's possible payment cannot be carried backward to make that loss vanish.

season_water_13_order_notice_005.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_order_notice_005.text: Yu's usual household carrier took both rolled panels by the currently authorized dry route, under the household's own arrangement. The carrier was paid from private funds already theirs, not the commons account. Lin and Qiu accompanied the short agreed part of the visit with empty hands. At the buyer's covered inspection table, the runner compared the two actual panels with the accepted size description while Yu and Jun retained permission to stop an inspection outside those terms.

season_water_13_order_notice_006.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_order_notice_006.text: The runner unfolded each panel, checked its repaired edges and stated size, and accepted both. He counted four copper from the buyer's own pouch. Yu checked the amount and put it into the household's private account. The buyer's carrier took the two accepted panels away. The household had completed the later two-panel sale at four copper, after actual work and inspection. No advance, facility fee, or new payment to Lin or Qiu was part of the exchange.

season_water_13_order_notice_007.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_order_notice_007.text: Jun kept the acknowledgment with the earlier canceled order. Today's four copper was two less than the original six expected on the lost departure, and the later sale had required its own work intervals. Yu said she was pleased the panels had passed and still wished the roof damage had not forced the smaller terms. Qiu did not convert the sound later work into an argument that the storm had somehow offered them a better bargain.

season_water_13_order_notice_008.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_order_notice_008.text: The household allowed Su to record only that the private accepted order had been fulfilled under its own terms. The panel price and household carrying arrangement remained outside the public seasonal display. Lin thanked Jun for reading the acknowledgment aloud at the table and asked no new permission to quote her relief. Jun wanted the buyer's slip put away before they discussed the market's public passage. Yu closed the envelope, and the conversation changed subjects.

season_water_13_order_rush_001.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_order_rush_001.text: The household's earlier bounded attempt had delivered one sound panel before the runner's stop time and earned three copper then. The remaining later order concerned the other panel, at two copper after inspection on the gathering's second morning. Jun brought that single remaining panel to the dry table. The delivered first panel belonged to its buyer and did not reappear in household storage merely because the women had come to hear how the later work would finish.

season_water_13_order_rush_002.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_order_rush_002.text: Jun showed the last damaged edge she had kept for an ordinary afternoon rather than rushing it with the first delivery. Yu steadied the panel while Jun loosened two unsound knots and replaced their damaged cord. Lin read the buyer's size description from her lap when asked; Qiu moved the cups away from the tools. The invited women watched actual craft without claiming it as their skill or making Jun perform a lesson she had not offered.

season_water_13_order_rush_003.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_order_rush_003.text: After the replacement settled, Jun and Yu checked the edge under the household's familiar method and the stated buyer condition. One loop sat unevenly and needed retying. Jun did it without the earlier runner's imminent departure pressing on her fingers. She rested before rolling the panel. The later promise had now become completed offered work in the room, but acceptance and payment still belonged to the buyer's actual inspection at the named gathering.

season_water_13_order_rush_004.speaker: lin_yue
season_water_13_order_rush_004.text: This is the remaining panel under the separate two-copper order. The earlier panel was already delivered for three copper. We should keep the two deliveries distinct if we help read your acknowledgment. Today's sound edge does not prove the earlier morning should have allowed more haste, and today's calmer work does not erase the effort Jun spent then. You have chosen and performed two particular undertakings, each with its own terms.

season_water_13_order_rush_005.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_order_rush_005.text: Yu's usual household carrier took the one rolled panel by the currently authorized dry route, under a private arrangement that did not draw on the commons fund. Lin and Qiu accompanied the short invited part of the visit with empty hands. At the covered inspection table, the runner checked the remaining panel's repaired edge and size against the separate later order. He did not count the earlier delivered panel again or claim a second present delivery from that first sale.

season_water_13_order_rush_006.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_order_rush_006.text: The runner accepted the single remaining panel and counted two copper from the buyer's own pouch after inspection. Yu checked and received it. The buyer's carrier took the accepted panel away. The household's actual two sales now totaled five copper: three earned on the earlier bounded delivery and two earned on this later one. The total was still one less than the original six expected together, with two different work intervals and departures behind it.

season_water_13_order_rush_007.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_order_rush_007.text: Jun put the later acknowledgment beside the earlier three-copper receipt and the canceled second delivery on the original terms. She said the separate sale had suited her fingers better today, while the first morning had left them aching. Qiu listened without claiming the total proved her liking for quick work correct. Yu wanted the five copper and wanted the concentrated earlier effort remembered as effort. Both wishes could remain in the household account.

season_water_13_order_rush_008.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_order_rush_008.text: The household allowed Su to record only that the accepted private order had been fulfilled under its own terms. The private price and carrier arrangement remained outside the seasonal facility ledger. Lin asked whether Jun wanted any sentence about the different work intervals carried into a public account. Jun said not today. Lin left the notebook closed. Yu put the two sale slips away before they turned to the gathering's dispute over public passage.

season_water_13_order_hold_001.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_order_hold_001.text: The household had declined the damaged panels' present deliveries and the offered later order. There was no accepted buyer deadline at this gathering, no advance, and no fee due from those canceled terms. Yu brought the acknowledgment to the dry table because she wanted that absence understood plainly. Jun unrolled the two panels that remained household property. They had used dry portions for their own work while keeping damaged edges out of use until repaired.

season_water_13_order_hold_002.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_order_hold_002.text: Jun showed the edge she wished to finish now for household use. Yu preferred repairing the other panel first because it would fit an ordinary storage need. They disagreed without a runner's departure deciding the matter. Lin sat with the cancellation slip on her lap and no inspection authority. Qiu kept the cups away from the tools. The women were invited company, and the choice to refuse a sale had not made them household craft advisers.

season_water_13_order_hold_003.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_order_hold_003.text: Yu and Jun settled on the first edge after checking what their own week required. Jun loosened the doubtful knots and replaced the damaged cord at her familiar pace. She stopped when her fingers needed rest and returned after water. Yu checked the settled edge with her ordinary household method. The work was actually performed in the visitors' presence, but it served their retained panel rather than an order the household had never accepted.

season_water_13_order_hold_004.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
season_water_13_order_hold_004.text: There is no buyer waiting at the gathering for these two panels under the canceled terms. I want to say that plainly because a completed repair can make people imagine a sale must follow. You kept the materials and gave up that particular money. Today's work gives you a sounder household edge, not a hidden payment. If you want another buyer someday, it will need a new actual offer and your own decision.

season_water_13_order_hold_005.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_order_hold_005.text: Jun rolled the repaired panel into its household place. The other remained marked for later ordinary attention, with damaged portions withheld from use. No buyer inspected either piece, no carrier removed them, and no copper from the canceled or declined offers arrived. Yu checked the cancellation acknowledgment once, then put it away. The household had no borrowing obligation to return these owned panels and no private order left silently waiting for completion at this gathering.

season_water_13_order_hold_006.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_order_hold_006.text: Yu said she had regretted the lost six copper when a needed purchase came due. Jun said she had felt relief every time a damp edge required another day without making her miss an accepted buyer date. Neither fact proved the refusal perfect or foolish. Lin listened without offering an imaginary later sale to balance the account. The household had retained its materials, accepted the missing money, and used its own time for actual work.

season_water_13_order_hold_007.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_order_hold_007.text: Su's brief private witness note remained only that she had heard the cancellation read. There was no new purchase agreement for the facility to hold, and no household sale to add to its ledger. Yu allowed the women to say only that the private terms were closed. The retained panels and their future uses were not donated to the seasonal display because the room might find them useful examples of cost and choice.

season_water_13_order_hold_008.speaker: narrator
season_water_13_order_hold_008.text: Jun put the cancellation envelope away and set a bowl of dry fruit on the cleared part of the table. Qiu asked whether she wanted to discuss the gathering's passage dispute now or after their food. Jun chose after. The household's refusal had returned some decisions to its own pace, without removing ordinary worry. Lin took a piece of fruit and left her brush untouched until the invited conversation actually changed subjects.
